## accept-failed-test

"accept" is not a choice: shipping past test failed criteria needs the person's own reason. They accept from the banner, or answer your question in their own words

## retry-stuck

"retry" is not a choice: on stuck it needs the person's own direction. They retry from the banner, or answer your question in their own words

## retry-not-converging

"retry" is not a choice: on not converging it needs the person's own direction. They retry from the banner, or answer your question in their own words

## amend-not-converging

"amend" is not a choice: on not converging it needs the person's own direction. They amend from the banner, or answer your question in their own words

## accept-not-converging

"accept" is not a choice: shipping past not converging needs the person's own reason. They accept from the banner, or answer your question in their own words
